questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical knowledge of Azure AD PIM, including JIT elevation, approval workflows, MFA enforcement, and incident response within real-world identity governance frameworks.

## Key Concepts
- Azure AD Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
- Just-in-Time elevation and activation windows
- Approval workflows and MFA enforcement
- Audit logs, SIEM integration, and anomaly detection
- Sandbox validation and rollback/auto-revocation mechanisms
- Testing plans and production readiness criteria

## Code Example
```bash
# Connect to Azure AD
Connect-AzureAD

# Enable PIM for a specific role
$role = Get-AzureADMSPrivilegedRoleDefinition -ProviderId aadRoles -ResourceId $tenantId | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq 'Global Administrator' }

# Assign a user as eligible with time-bound activation
Open-AzureADMSPrivilegedRoleAssignmentRequest -ProviderId aadRoles -RoleDefinitionId $role.Id -ResourceId $tenantId -SubjectId $userId -AssignmentType User -Type AdminAdd -Reason 'JIT access for contractor' -Duration 'PT4H' -ApprovalId $approvalWorkflowId

# Verify MFA enforcement in activation settings
Set-AzureADMSPrivilegedRoleSetting -ProviderId aadRoles -ResourceId $tenantId -RoleDefinitionId $role.Id -UserMemberSettings $activationSettings
```

Target CA policies to the enterprise application object in Azure AD—not the App Proxy connector—to ensure CA evaluates before App Proxy. ## Sign-in Risk Risk is evaluated per authentication step. For JIT admin role elevation, create a separate CA policy targeting the Azure AD Role Management service, or use PIM to handle Just-in-Time elevation separately. ## Entitlement Management Controls access entitlement duration (max 365 days). JIT uses shorter durations like 30 minutes. Assignment requires approval. Policy expiration triggers automatic de-provisioning when the session ends. ## Device Compliance Intune device compliance policies must be assigned to device groups containing admin accounts. Require hybrid Azure AD join for on-premises-managed devices, or compliant unmanaged for BYOD. ## Trusted Locations Configure named locations with internal IP ranges (RFC 1918 addresses) to exclude admin networks from MFA requirements. ## Validation Always validate in a separate dev/test environment before production. Use Report-only mode first to see outcomes without blocking. ## Rollback Triggers Documented runbooks for each failure scenario with defined RBAC thresholds. ## Monitoring Dashboards Aggregate signals from Azure AD, Intune, and Defender for Cloud Apps into a unified zero-trust visibility workbook.
